def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bg=max(set(v for row in grid for v in row),key=lambda v:sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    pts=[(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=bg]
    for r,c,v in pts:
        for rr,cc,vv in pts:
            dr,dc=rr-r,cc-c
            if vv!=v or dr==0 or dc==0 or abs(dr)!=abs(dc): continue
            sr=1 if dr>0 else -1; sc=1 if dc>0 else -1
            x,y=rr+sr,cc+sc
            while 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and out[x][y]==bg:
                out[x][y]=v; x+=sr; y+=sc
    return out
